hero.subtitle: Custom boxes, professional labels: technology, expertise and support for your business.

solutions.packagingDesc: Automatic box makers, single-pass printers for corrugated cardboard, die-cutting and digital gluing systems.

solutions.bookEdgingDesc: Digital printing on book, notebook and notepad edges for unique, high-quality customisation.
solutions.consumablesDesc: Inks, print heads, ribbons and original consumable materials for all distributed printers.
